defect: Admission and continuation hashed the redacted profile, so metadata-only execution changes shared one identity.
failureScenario: A user changes private runtime metadata and sends again -> Braid can reuse admission or a provider session created for the prior profile.
fix: Use agent-interface canonical identity for the exact validated AgentProfile at every execution boundary.
verification: pnpm check -> 586 passed, 0 failed, 2 protected skips
costIfShipped: 1 wrong execution binding per 1 tested metadata-only profile change
savedIfFixed: 1 rejected stale binding per 1 tested metadata-only profile change

defect: Restart could replace an exact loaded profile with a redacted durable copy or retain one after durable identity changed.
failureScenario: Braid restarts with private profile metadata -> the next run either loses required metadata or executes stale metadata.
evidence: test/application.test.ts restart exact-match, mismatch, and legacy-digest cases
fix: Persist the exact execution digest and retain loaded metadata only on an exact digest match.
costIfShipped: 3 wrong restart outcomes per 3 tested restart states
savedIfFixed: 3 correct restart outcomes per 3 tested restart states

defect: Profile snapshots could retain nested metadata bags containing private execution values.
failureScenario: A profile contains secrets in root, model, MCP, subagent, or mode metadata -> export or durable evidence stores them.
evidence: test/profiles.test.ts nested metadata canary and schema round trip
fix: Replace every metadata bag with one schema-valid redaction object before persistence.
verification: pnpm test:security -> 129 passed, 0 failed; staged gitleaks -> no leaks
costIfShipped: 5 leak paths per 5 tested metadata locations
savedIfFixed: 5 redacted paths per 5 tested metadata locations

defect: Evaluation redaction only matched selected field names and recursed without depth, item, byte, or cycle limits.
failureScenario: A provider response contains a bearer value, secret URL, cycle, deep tree, or huge value -> evidence leaks or the recorder fails.
fix: Route every evaluation value through the shared bounded structured sanitizer and retain canary replacement.
verification: semantic run -> 6 of 6 cases, 18 of 18 fixtures, 73 of 73 calls passed
costIfShipped: 6 unsafe input classes per 6 tested classes
savedIfFixed: 6 sanitized input classes per 6 tested classes

defect: Structured redaction used per-container limits, unsafe property assignment, and a second unbounded telemetry walk.
failureScenario: Hostile nested objects, colliding sanitized keys, __proto__, or cycles -> excessive traversal, prototype mutation, or incomplete redaction.
evidence: test/sanitize.test.ts and test/eval.test.ts depth, cycle, key, and item cases
fix: Use one traversal budget, safe own-property writes, bounded keys, cycle tracking, and in-pass telemetry preservation.
verification: pnpm test:security -> 129 passed; module graph -> 443 modules, 0 cycles
costIfShipped: 4 unsafe structures per 4 tested structure classes
savedIfFixed: 4 bounded structures per 4 tested structure classes

defect: The small untrusted-value budget truncated Braid's complete semantic record after two cases.
failureScenario: A stopped or full semantic run writes six cases -> cases EVAL-03 through EVAL-06 disappear and record validation crashes.
evidence: pre-fix pnpm test:eval failed with four missing case errors; post-fix unavailable and paid records retain 6 of 6
fix: Keep small payload limits and add a separate 4 MiB value and 100,000-item budget for complete artifacts and their hashes.
verification: paid semantic record -> 1,461,059 bytes, 22,660 paths, 6 cases, 73 receipts, releaseAdmissible true

defect: Runtime's valid aggregate token record with tokensKnown false was rejected as token-shaped data.
failureScenario: agent-runtime reports input and output totals with incomplete status -> Braid drops spend evidence.
fix: Accept only input, output, and optional tokensKnown false under exact aggregate record names.
verification: pnpm test:security -> runtime spend record persisted and remained redacted
costIfShipped: 1 lost spend record per 1 tested Runtime event shape
savedIfFixed: 1 retained spend record per 1 tested Runtime event shape

defect: Non-finite and negative numeric telemetry could survive restoration or become misleading values.
failureScenario: A provider emits negative, NaN, or infinite token counts -> evidence treats invalid usage as measured.
fix: Preserve only finite non-negative numbers and reject malformed aggregate records.
costIfShipped: 4 invalid values accepted per 4 tested values
savedIfFixed: 4 invalid values redacted per 4 tested values

defect: Conversation export used the generic 20,000-item budget and truncated valid longer histories.
failureScenario: A 258-message conversation exports and imports -> later receipt and event fields disappear.
evidence: test/application.test.ts 258-message export, import, and restart regression
fix: Share one 100,000-item document limit across export and import while keeping the 2 MiB byte limit.
verification: pnpm test:unit -> long conversation round trip passed
costIfShipped: 1 truncated history per 1 tested long conversation
savedIfFixed: 258 retained messages per 1 tested long conversation

defect: Partial analysis cost displayed the observed minimum but discarded a separate estimate.
failureScenario: A run has measured calls and an incomplete authoritative estimate -> the user cannot see likely total spend.
fix: Keep observed and estimated cost as separate fields and derive status from both.
verification: pnpm test:unit -> all partial, complete, and estimate-only cost cases passed
costIfShipped: 1 missing estimate per 1 tested partial-cost session
savedIfFixed: 2 distinct cost facts shown per 1 tested partial-cost session

defect: Visual proof waited for a two-second transient exit frame before sending the second Ctrl+C.
failureScenario: The host is heavily loaded -> the prompt renders and expires between polls, so valid packed proof times out.
evidence: pre-fix state-empty capture timed out at load average 53; packed lifecycle proof passed the same product path
fix: Send the documented two-key sequence directly, then assert the prompt in retained output and require exit code zero.
verification: pnpm proof:w6 -> 75 artifacts, 11 states, clean normal exit
costIfShipped: 1 false proof failure per 1 observed loaded capture
